author: Inside Edition
description: A suspect took a daring leap out the front window of a house, right into the custody of police. It happened in Sanford Florida. Cops say they surrounded a house where a person with an active warrant was refusing to leave. Bodycam video shows the suspect running through the house, with officers running to the front hoping to catch him at the other end. He surprised all of them with his powerful exit. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspect Dives Through Window Of House Into Police Custody

author: Inside Edition
description: Not all heroes wear capes, but this one was dressed as a piece of fruit. Stephanie Oropeza was wearing a banana suit and heading home from a Halloween party in Orlando Florida. At 4 a.m. an SUV swerved off the road, smashing into a restaurant. Restaurant security cameras showed the human banana calling police and then flagging down officers as they rushed to the scene. Inside Edition spoke with Oropeza.
title: Woman In Banana Costume Saves The Day After Car Crashes Into Restaurant

author: Inside Edition
description: One of the last remaining cast members of the original "Star Trek" TV series died. Actor and screenwriter Walter Koenig passed away on Sunday at his Hollywood home, his representatives announced in a statement. The son of Russian-Jewish immigrants, Koenig played the youthful navigator, Ensign Pavel Chekov, aboard the USS Enterprise. His Russian character represented a hopeful note of future international peace during the height of the Cold War. Walter Koenig was 90 years old.
title: Original 'Star Trek' Cast Member Walter Koenig Dies At 90

author: Inside Edition
description: The modern voice of classic cartoon characters has died. Eric Bauza was the voice of iconic characters including Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, and many others in recent Looney Toons productions. Bauza, born in Canada, had a voice acting career that spanned 20 years, according to his IMDb profile. Friends, family and colleagues are remembering him as a playful person with a passion for his craft. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Eric Bauza, Voice Of Bugs Bunny And Other Looney Tunes Characters, Dies At 46
